frames.title: Lesson 73 · Advanced participle clauses — practice and contrast

body: **Foco:** Advanced participle clauses — prática e contraste.
**Pronúncia:** Ênfase intencional.
**22 palavras novas** (comunicação intercultural).
**Texto do dia:** e-mail, carta, mensagem.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo contrastar orações participiais (-ing, perfect, passive) e orações com conectores, num e-mail intercultural.

body: Esta aula treina **ler textos curtos e achar informação (IELTS Reading, TOEFL Reading)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.subject: Meeting recap
paras: **Having reviewed** the notes, I realize some points were unclear. **Not wanting** to create confusion, I am sending this summary. **Held** in two languages, the meeting required patience; **given** the time difference, we shall keep calls short.
**Having agreed** the next steps, we can proceed. **Asked** about deadlines, Marta said Friday. **With everyone aligned**, the launch should go smoothly.

items.q: The meeting was held in one language.
Marta gave Friday as the deadline.
Ana sends a summary to avoid confusion.

head: Com participial
Com conector
rows: Having reviewed the notes, I realize…
**After I had reviewed the notes, I realize…**
Not wanting to create confusion, I send…
**Because I do not want to create confusion, I send…**
Held in two languages, the meeting required patience.
**Because it was held in two languages, the meeting…**
With everyone aligned, we can start.
**Now that everyone is aligned, we can start.**

blocks.body: A participial é mais **compacta e formal**. Cuidado com o **sujeito**: deve ser o mesmo da principal (*Having reviewed the notes, I…*).

items.s: ___ reviewed the notes, I realize some points were unclear. (Having)
___ wanting to create confusion, I am sending this. (Not)
___ in two languages, the meeting required patience. (Held)
With everyone ___ , the launch should go well. (aligned)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.ans: With everyone aligned we can launch

body: **Get everyone on the same page.** — Alinhar todos.
**Touch base.** — Entrar em contato.
**Circle back.** — Voltar ao assunto.
**Loop in.** — Incluir na conversa.
**For your reference.** — Para sua referência.
**Going forward,…** — Daqui para frente,…
**As discussed,…** — Conforme discutido,…
**Following up on…** — Dando seguimento a…
**With everyone aligned, we can launch.** — Com todos alinhados, podemos lançar.
**Having reviewed the notes, I realize some points were unclear.** — Tendo revisado as anotações, percebo que alguns pontos ficaram obscuros.
**Not wanting to create confusion, you sent a summary.** — Não querendo criar confusão, você enviou um resumo.

blocks.title: Global call
lines: Having reviewed the notes, I realize some points were unclear.
Tendo revisado as anotações, percebo que alguns pontos ficaram obscuros.
Not wanting to create confusion, you sent a summary.
Não querendo criar confusão, você enviou um resumo.
Held in two languages, the meeting needed patience.
Realizada em dois idiomas, a reunião exigiu paciência.
With everyone aligned, we can launch.

items.label: Ênfase intencional
items.note: A ênfase intencional destaca a palavra que carrega o sentido: sílaba forte, mais longa e mais alta. Mudar a palavra enfatizada muda a mensagem.
words: I didn’t say HE stole it.
I didn’t SAY he stole it.
Not only did she COME, she LED.

prompts.model: Not wanting to be late, I left early.
With the work done, we left.

blocks.task: Write a 6-line recap e-mail using at least four participle clauses.
blocks.model: Hi team, having reviewed the notes, I realize some points were unclear. Not wanting to create confusion, I am sending this summary. Held in two languages, the meeting required patience. Having agreed the next steps, we can proceed. Asked about deadlines, Marta said Friday. With everyone aligned, the launch should go smoothly. Best, Ana

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
